verdict: A correct, idiomatic sign-in form built only from real Baklava bl-input/bl-button components with validated attributes (type, autocomplete, minlength, required on inputs; type=submit/variant/label on button) and working imperative reportValidity handling. Minor accessibility polish (associating the generic role=alert error to the fields via aria-describedby and per-field messages) and novalidate-on-form reliance are the only notes; otherwise clean, minimal, and highly maintainable.
